description: This Python module provides a minimal client for interacting with Supabase's PostgREST API, including functions for constructing headers with user JWTs or service roles, and a client class for making async HTTP requests to perform CRUD operations. It is specifically tailored for a FastAPI backend environment and emphasizes RLS (Row Level Security)-aware interactions.

classes.name: SupabaseRestClient
classes.description: A minimal asynchronous HTTP client for interacting with Supabase PostgREST endpoints, handling request construction, response processing, and error management.

methods.description: Retrieves the Supabase URL from environment variables.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] postgrest_headers_from_user(*, access_token: str)
methods.description: Constructs headers for PostgREST requests using a user JWT token, including the anonymous key.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] postgrest_headers_service_role()
methods.description: Constructs headers for PostgREST requests using the service role key to bypass RLS.
